summary: Pulse Biosciences filed an 8-K furnishing preliminary Q1 2026 financial results and providing an update on accelerated enrollment in its NANOPULSE-AF clinical trial. The expected results show approximately $68.3 million cash, $0.4 million product revenue, and an $18.6 million net loss. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, is described. The filing is a routine current report on operations and clinical progress, not a special situation.
